# Section loader

Copies each section and sets bit (id-1) in the loaded mask.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x600457e7` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [ep7 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/ep7-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-P7](../cameras/ep7.md)

Boot then waits on each section in turn (USRSTART2).
